dataList.desc: ได้รับตัวตน
dataList.dlg:
ความทรงจำ ประสบการณ์ เราสงสัยจังว่า สิ่งใดคือหลักฐานพิสูจน์ตัวตนของ "เรา" กัน?
เราได้ปีนป่ายขึ้นไปอีกครั้ง เพื่อตามหาคำตอบที่ไม่มีผู้ใดสามารถมอบให้แก่เราได้

A season begins again, and before long, it comes to an end. Then when one season ends, another begins.
Season after season, the events within remain the same; but they are, in truth, trapped in a greater cycle: the cycle of the Voices—or, rather, the "Giants."

I thought the sunlight, the alien Voice... held the answer to my question. But... the sunlight gave me no answers, instead offering only encouragement...
Maybe I don't yet have anything that I... truly desire...

Off-season... sale...? But why keep these piled here? I don't get it.
If they don't sell, just eat them up. Start with the nearest dish, then move on to the next one until there's none left.

Watching everything unfold exactly as I'd known it would is... such a scary feeling. So why does the Obsidian God keep trying to decide how everything must end? What worth could there be in a hollow cycle... that only spins in place...?

... The longer the adventure gets, the more I find words and expressions that I can't share with others. And even when I do, they don't seem to understand me.
Maybe that's why I've begun talking to myself more and more frequently. At least the hunger subsides a little when I'm chewing on something.

Why does everything have to end with death? Why can't we just start from the beginning again? I... don't get it. I don't like it.
Why can't we just start over after we die? That way, we wouldn't ever have to hesitate before making a choice... That way, we could keep experiencing...

As I uncovered more and more of the unknown world, the cold retreated to an unseen corner of my mind; the hunger beneath my notice as the hollow of my heart filled.
But now that I have learned all there is to be learned... I feel only the cold... and the loneliness.

This insatiable emptiness... this unquenchable thirst... Neither of these is mine, yet I cannot help but think they are.
Every thread that comprises my being is... a wish of another, nailed into the sense of hunger. Then, this instinctive, unbearable voracity has to be... my nature, my fate to bear.
Undo only the silkiest threads... Grow tall and strong...

dataList.desc: ผูกมัดตัวตน
dataList.dlg: และในท้ายที่สุด บุฟเฟต์ก็ถูกเสิร์ฟ ทั้งพวกเรา ทั้งตัวเรา จักกลืนกินทั้งห้างสรรพสินค้าแห่งนี้จากรากฐานถึงยอดสุด เพื่อที่พวกเจ้าจะได้ไม่มีผู้ใดขูดกินจานอันว่างเปล่าอีก
I can't stop if I'm going to reach what I desire.
I don the virtues and ascend.
... ทำไมถึงเรียกเรางั้นเหรอ?
... หากมีสิ่งใดที่อยากถาม ยกมือของตนขึ้นแล้วรอ เราจะตอบคำถามเหล่านั้นทีละคำถาม
เราหยุดตัวเองไม่ได้แล้ว
หลั่งไหล
หลบไปนะ...
เราตื่มตราบเท่าที่เรากระหาย
เจ็บจัง...
เจ็บเหลือเกิน...
... จงตกระกำ
เรากินเพราะหิวเท่านั้น
ครั้งต่อไปเรา... จักปีนให้สูงขึ้นอีก...
... เราไม่อยาก... เจ็บอีกต่อไปแล้ว...
I just happened to know the answer ahead of time. It wasn't... a divine prophecy or anything.
There is no better way to escape our fate.

I am a being woven from threads of fathomless hunger... This paltry "feast" cannot fill me.
Bring me more. Scour for the Obsidian God's delicacies and present them before me—I should like to devour all that comes within my sight.
Mark my words, Obsidian God. At the end of this adventure... I will wrest free of my fate as you have gazed it.
... I am once again reduced to an experience. I am still nothing more than an experience that ravenously devours...
